title: Multiplication by a compactly supported smooth function is sequentially continuous from 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) to 𝒟^k(U)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, and ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ U. Let (ω_j) be a sequence in 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ k) with ω_j → 0 in Simon's test-form topology (TestFormOnConverges ωs 0: some compact K′ ⊆ ℝ^P contains tsupport ω_j for every j and tsupport 0, and for every l, D^l ω_j → D^l 0 uniformly on K′), and let (η_j) be a sequence in 𝒟^k(U) (TestFormOn U k) with η_j(x) = ζ(x)•ω_j(x) for all j and x. Then η_j → 0 in 𝒟^k(U), i.e. TestFormOnConverges ηs 0: some compact K ⊆ U contains tsupport η_j for every j and tsupport 0, and for every l, D^l η_j → D^l 0 uniformly on K.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (ηs : ℕ → TestFormOn U k), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → (∀ j x, (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = ζ x • (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) → TestFormOnConverges ηs 0
